decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrates (ACT) are a flagship tied to the firm's announced move into higher-value connectivity and 3D-integration applications and build on core glass processing know-how; continued website presence and the growing glass-substrate market give management strong reasons, including sunk investment, to persist.

VLIS laser structuring for through-glass vias was only launched in 2024 with a dedicated page and a public flagship framing, reflects recent investment in new processing technology central to the firm's strategy, and any slow uptake can still be attributed to normal ramp-up in semiconductor qualification cycles.
